title: Junior Series Europe: card flavor text

entities.name: Slith
entities.description: Creatures that incubate in the Great Furnace's heat and emerge on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns align.

entities.name: Great Furnace
entities.description: A place of heat where slith incubate.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: A people who bury slain warriors with a tree sapling so they become part of the forest.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A place where, a priest says, there is even greater need for prayer.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: A deity elves honor and whose slights they resent.
